decisions.reason: Restricting available theme colors does not change the established font sizes, emphasis, or typography requirements.
The approved-color restriction does not change the requirement to implement the style system across all templates or its listed style additions.
Theme-color availability is independent of the Board Meeting behavior for adding lines without unintended borders.
The source does not alter bullet sizing, spacing, alignment, scaling, or the required green level-4 bullet; it only limits colors exposed as theme options.
The color-palette decision does not change paragraph spacing, hard-return behavior, or Shift+Enter expectations.
Restricting theme-color options does not affect fixed margins or prevention of graphic clipping.
The theme-color restriction does not change multiline entry behavior or the designated interactive fields.
Color availability is independent of whether placeholder text clears when an interactive field is activated.
The source decision does not resolve or change Tab-controlled list hierarchy and alignment behavior.
Restricting theme colors does not change field-label language, text, coverage, placement, or persistence.
Theme-color availability does not affect the mechanism or robustness of editable text-field controls.
The approved-color restriction does not change the required legacy copy-paste workflow, test sources, or target template version.
